changes: First release: 74 factory programs of the Alesis Quadraverb (1989) on FX2: reverbs, choruses, flanges, echoes, pitch shifts, Leslies and the programs that combine them.
PROG (A) picks the program by its number on the original Quadraverb; MIX (F) sets dry and wet, 0 exact dry.
LEN, TIME, SPD and DEP (B-E) move decay or feedback, pre-delay or delay time and the sweep from the factory value, live.
Needs the Modwerk base with program areas and the stream channel, over USB.
Known issue: not compared with a real Quadraverb; reverb times are about 5 % shorter than the original's.
Known issue: the gated programs, VERB SHIFTER and two pitch shifts (51, 60) are not in this release yet.
